Codebase conventions that are load-bearing here: fail-closed authorization; the server is authoritative and never trusts a client claim; secrets scrubbed from logs; hand-written route responses emit { error, code } (requestId is produced ONLY by the global error handler at index.js:5402, so do not fabricate it on 4xx); forward-only numbered migrations with an explicit ON DELETE policy named on every FK; enumerations as VARCHAR(n) CHECK (col IN (...)) — no Postgres ENUM types exist anywhere; versioned-key field encryption via token-server/crypto.js (TEXT blob + companion *_key_version SMALLINT, the migration-016 convention); audit via auth.auditLog only, never a hand-rolled INSERT into audit_events; tier gating via tiers.js predicates. key_patterns: Server: tiers.js is pure predicates only (TIER_RANKS free0/pro1/hiring2, FEATURES, FEATURE_MIN_TIER, isFeatureAllowed fails closed on an unknown feature); requireTier lives in auth.js:552 but the interview paths do NOT use it — they inline tiers.isFeatureAllowed(req.user.tier, tiers.FEATURES.HOST_INTERVIEW) and hand-roll 403 { error, code:'INSUFFICIENT_TIER', currentTier, requiredTier } (index.js:2409, scheduling.js:163). The real tier code string is INSUFFICIENT_TIER — TIER_INSUFFICIENT does NOT exist. There is NO RATE_LIMITED code string anywhere today; only 3 of 6 limiters set Retry-After (makeAuthRateLimiter at index.js:248 does, rateLimitRoomAction at index.js:383 does not). toolsEntitlement(hostTier) at index.js:461 is the precedent for deriving an in-room entitlement from the room creator's snapshotted tier, not the joiner's. validateModerator(code, callerIdentity, userId) at index.js:2223 cross-checks the body-supplied callerIdentity against redis.hget(roomUserBindingKey(code), callerIdentity) and then requires a role in MODERATOR_ROLES ['host','co-host','interviewer'] — this is the load-bearing moderator-authz invariant. Leave-token participant auth precedent: index.js:5219 compares redis.get(roomLeaveTokenKey(code, identity)); constantTimeEqual is at index.js:423. auth.auditLog(userId, eventType, ipAddress, metadata) at auth.js:713 is the ONLY audit_events writer, never awaited; audit_events (migration 011) forbids UPDATE and DELETE via DB triggers, event_type is capped at 50 chars, has no room_code column (correlate in metadata JSONB) and user_id is nullable ON DELETE SET NULL. DI-for-testability house pattern for extractable logic: joinGuards.js (createJoinCapGuard), roomReconcile.js (createReconcileEmptyRoom), recordingQuota.js (isRecordingOverCap + createOverdueRecordingSweeper) — build in index.js, unit-test with fakes. Sweeper scheduling: setInterval inside `if (require.main === module)` at index.js:5762, errors caught, .unref()ed (see recordingSweepTimer at 5781). Routers mount at index.js:139-152 after the app-level auth.authenticateToken at 135. express.json() at 112 has NO limit option so the Express default 100 KB body cap applies. Client: three-file triad per screen — XView.swift (pure SwiftUI reading an @ObservedObject) + XViewModel.swift (@Published state + intents + handler closures, unit-tested directly) + InterXHostView.swift/InterXBridge.swift (@objc NSObject/NSView bridge exposing setFoo: mutators and fooHandler closures so AppDelegate.m can drive it). Pure derivation logic goes in nonisolated static funcs on the view model so it is enumerable in tests (the deriveRemoteTileState discipline from the consent-first moderation spec). Panels are presented as NSPopover + NSHostingController (InterCallControlBarBridge.presentRequestsPanel, line ~226). Modal screens are an Inter*HostView NSView in an NSWindow with onPrimary/onCancel blocks (AppDelegate -showGreenRoomWithRole: line 1845). Every protected window calls [window setSharingType:InterWindowSharingType()] rather than hardcoding NSWindowSharingNone. Capture-session consumers add and remove ONLY their own AVCaptureVideoDataOutput with videoSettings pinned to kCVPixelFormatType_32BGRA, never call startRunning/stopRunning, never touch session inputs — see the ISOLATION INVARIANT header of inter/Networking/InterLiveKitCameraSource.swift. Do NOT co-opt InterLocalMediaController.recordingFrameObserver: it is a single-slot atomic property owned by InterRecordingCoordinator and taking it breaks local recording's camera PiP. Stage surfaces (anything inside the call/secure window) are FIXED dark in both app appearances — InterColor.stage #101012 / stageSurface #18181B / stageElevated #27272A, text white/#E5E5E5/#A3A3A3; never make them appearance-aware. Compiled radii differ from the handoff doc: InterRadius sm 4, md 6, lg 6, bubble 8, xl 10, xxl 10. InterControl primaryHeight 40 / secondaryHeight 36 / compactHeight 32. InterSpacing x1 4, x2 8 (preferred), x3 12, x4 16, x6 24 — no off-grid values. InterStatus success #10B981 / warning #F59E0B / danger #EF4444 / brand #7C3AED.
